prompt_text: Which title company in Fort Lauderdale FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company—the right choice depends on your transaction, fees, and how responsive the team is. **Heritage Title Insurance Agency** is a reasonable first call: it has a downtown Fort Lauderdale office and handles title review, escrow, and closing coordination. **Palm Title** and **Gibraltar Title** are also local options to compare.

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of title and closing fees, who will handle your file, whether they regularly handle your type of transaction (such as a condo or cash purchase), and how they protect wire transfers. Also confirm with your lender that the company is acceptable. In Florida, the purchase contract may specify who selects the title agent, so check that first.
